system.description: The core: 28 tools costing 2–4 IP each; gain two per Skill Level. Inventory action + the tool's IP applies its effect to a target you can see — no Check, and option-choosing tools are fixed when created. Tool damage on your Bounty ignores Resistances. New tools may be invented and bought (~1000z).
